task.description: Combined Step 0.5 (registry lookup) + Step 1 (diagnose) for ISS-0511. This issue's root cause is already substantially diagnosed in docs/issues/ISS-0511.yaml (read it in full) and independently confirmed by ORCH by reading the actual test code: test/letflow/simulation/req207_vortex_test.exs, the 'vortex-entity-list-filter-and-page' test (around lines 879-915). The test finds every docs/requirements.yaml line whose title: matches /entit(y|ies)/i, then for each match does `Enum.at(title_lines, idx - 1)` (line ~908) to get exactly ONE line immediately above and asserts it is an id: line naming one of a fixed allowed set (REQ-207, REQ-225..231). REQ-257 (merged, correct per REQ-237/ISS-0510 -- do NOT touch docs/requirements.yaml) inserted a `# PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):` comment line between id: and title: for 6 of those 7 entries (REQ-225, REQ-227, REQ-228, REQ-229, REQ-230, REQ-231). For those 6, `idx - 1` now lands on the PROVENANCE comment line, not the id: line, so the assertion fails. Step 0.5: check docs/issues/*.yaml for any prior resolved entry with a similar id:/title:-adjacency or PROVENANCE-marker-parsing symptom (this looks novel, but confirm). Step 1: confirm this root cause by actually running `mix test test/letflow/simulation/req207_vortex_test.exs` on this branch (pre-fix) and quoting the real failure output -- do not just trust the issue file's prose (No Speculation / core-directives.md). Then state precisely what a fix must change: the walk-back logic must skip over any intervening comment line(s) (lines matching /^\s*#/ once trimmed) between the title: line and the nearest preceding id: line, rather than assuming exact adjacency (idx - 1). Note for the design step: the fix must still correctly reject a genuinely wrong/missing id: (i.e. walking back must stop at the first non-comment, non-blank line and require THAT to be the id: line -- it must not skip past a real content line searching for an id: further up). Do NOT implement the fix yourself. Do NOT modify docs/requirements.yaml.

result.summary:
Step 0.5 (registry lookup): searched docs/issues/*.yaml (282 files) for a prior resolved entry with a matching id:/title:-adjacency or PROVENANCE-marker-parsing symptom. Grepped for 'adjacency', 'PROVENANCE', 'walk-back', 'idx - 1' -- only ISS-0511 itself matched. Also checked all vortex/req207-tagged issues (ISS-0388, ISS-0391, ISS-0392, ISS-0393, ISS-0411) and the directly-referenced ISS-0510 (the REQ-237 design-doc amendment that authorized the PROVENANCE marker's placement between id: and title:) -- none describe this test's own adjacency-assumption bug; ISS-0510 is the design precursor, not a resolved instance of this symptom. Confirmed: no matching prior resolved issue exists. This is a novel issue, not a recurrence.

Step 1 (diagnose): ran `mix test test/letflow/simulation/req207_vortex_test.exs` on this branch (pre-fix, real Postgres). Result: 3/4 passed, 1 failed. Actual failure output:

  1) test vortex-entity-list-filter-and-page disposition is BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCY, re-verified live against real source state (design §4.1) (Letflow.Simulation.Req207VortexTest)
     test/letflow/simulation/req207_vortex_test.exs:856
     Expected the line preceding each entity title: match to carry one of ["REQ-207", "REQ-225", "REQ-226", "REQ-227", "REQ-228", "REQ-229", "REQ-230", "REQ-231"], got: "    # PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):\r"
     code: Enum.each(matched_ids, fn preceding_line ->
     test/letflow/simulation/req207_vortex_test.exs:911: (test)

Root cause confirmed exactly as diagnosed in docs/issues/ISS-0511.yaml and the handoff task description: in the 'vortex-entity-list-filter-and-page' test, for each docs/requirements.yaml line whose title: matches /entit(y|ies)/i (found via Enum.with_index/Enum.filter at lines 882-889), the code at line 908 does `Enum.at(title_lines, idx - 1)` -- a single-line, exact-adjacency walk-back that assumes the id: line is always exactly one line above title:. REQ-257 correctly inserted a `# PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):` comment line between id: and title: for REQ-225, REQ-227, REQ-228, REQ-229, REQ-230, REQ-231 (per the REQ-237/ISS-0510 convention, which is correct and must not be reverted -- confirmed via ISS-0510's resolution notes). For those 6 entries, idx - 1 now lands on the PROVENANCE comment line instead of the id: line, so the `preceding_line =~ "id: #{&1}"` assertion at line 912 fails. Only REQ-226 (no PROVENANCE marker) and REQ-207 (self-referential title) still pass under the old assumption, hence 6 of 7 allowed ids being effectively broken but only 1 test failure surfacing (Enum.each stops at first failing element, alphabetically/positionally REQ-225 or whichever sorts first in file order).

Additional confirmed detail not in the original issue prose: docs/requirements.yaml has CRLF line endings -- the failing line's captured value ends in a literal \r ("...authority):\r"). Any fix must account for this when trimming/matching comment lines (e.g. trim \r\n, not just \n, before checking a line against /^\s*#/ or blank).

Precise fix requirement for CODE-DESIGNER: replace the single-line `Enum.at(title_lines, idx - 1)` walk-back with a walk-back loop that, starting at idx - 1 and moving upward, skips lines that are blank or match a comment pattern (line trimmed of trailing \r and leading/trailing whitespace matches /^#/), and stops at the first non-blank, non-comment line -- that line must be the one checked against the allowed id: set. Critically, the loop must NOT continue skipping past a real (non-comment, non-blank) content line while searching further up for an id: -- if the first non-comment/non-blank line found is not an id: line (or no such line exists before the start of the list/file), the test must still fail, preserving the original defect-detection intent (catching a genuinely wrong or missing id: line). This is a bounded skip-comments-only walk-back, not an unbounded search for the nearest id: anywhere above.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER to design the fix per the walk-back requirement stated in this summary, then CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, ELIXIR-DEV (or TEST-DESIGNER, since owned_modules is a test file) to implement, then TEST-RUNNER to confirm test/letflow/simulation/req207_vortex_test.exs passes 4/4.
